_notes: Indicative spot freight. Dry bulk in USD per WET metric tonne shipped (wmt, the basis Baltic C-routes are fixed on); the engine converts to USD/dmt with the cargo moisture. Tanker in USD/bbl. Levels consistent with Baltic Exchange dry indices and Worldscale-derived tanker economics; the Worldscale/vessel-size complexity deliberately stays in this table, not in the core engine.

morebaya_qingdao.basis: USD/wmt, Capesize West Africa -> China (C3 Tubarao->Qingdao proxy plus West Africa premium)

morebaya_rotterdam.basis: USD/wmt, Capesize Guinea -> NW Europe short Atlantic leg

ras_tanura_ningbo.basis: USD/bbl, VLCC AG -> China (TD3C at mid-cycle Worldscale, ~2m bbl stem)

ras_tanura_rotterdam.basis: USD/bbl, Suezmax AG -> NW Europe via Suez incl. canal dues

kamsar_yantai.basis: USD/wmt, Capesize Guinea bauxite -> Shandong (transhipped Capesize, C3-plus level)

lobito_qingdao.basis: USD/wmt, Supramax concentrate West Africa -> China

lobito_huelva.basis: USD/wmt, Supramax concentrate West Africa -> Spain

dar_es_salaam_fangchenggang.basis: USD/wmt, Supramax concentrate East Africa -> South China
